There are three types of messages. PMs, comment replies, and post replys/user mentions.

When you click on the envelope it will take you two one of those three lists depending on where you have new mail.

Only pms need to be marked as read and they will show as new messages until you do. The others stop showing as new one you have looked at the message list that contains them.

So if it shows you have 5 new messages, and it turns out 3 are comment replies and 2 are post replies. When you click on mail it will show you the comment replies and change the mail icon to 2. Click on mail again, or post replies and it will show you that list and change the mail number to 0.

If you have no new comment or post replies then clicking on mail will take you to PMs.
